title: project-LICHEN-n8c6 review: key-change detection test removed from test_link_layer.py
description: Commit 45cd828 removed the pin-overwrite/second-receive test case from test_key_change_detection in python/tests/link/test_link_layer.py. This test verified that overwriting the pinned key and then receiving a frame from the same peer with the original signature correctly results in KEY_CHANGE error. The removal reduces test coverage for key-change detection.
